odc_type: Type inference leakage across unrelated record types
observation_summary: The compiler fails to report an error for accessing a property that does not exist on a specific record type when another unrelated record type in the same scope happens to define that property.
reasoning_summary: The bug occurs because the type checker incorrectly allows properties defined in one record type to be accessed on an unrelated record type. When multiple record types are present in the scope, the compiler fails to isolate their property definitions, leading to a false positive where it assumes a property exists on a record type even if it was only defined in a completely different, unrelated record type. This causes the type checker to suppress expected warnings about undefined properties.
